# DDC Founder and CEO's Letter to Shareholders


November 05, 2026 9:57 AM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_68ac8a9433627085001b07778e567f83/daydaycook/news/2026-11-05_DDC_Founder_and_CEO_s_Letter_to_96.pdf)


### DDC launches SAVOR Series A 13.5% Perpetual Preferred Shares (SVOR) and outlines plan to retire its outstanding convertible note


NEW YORK, Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- DDC Enterprise Limited (NYSE American: DDC) ("DDC" or the "Company"), a global Asian food platform and digital asset treasury company, today issued a Letter to Shareholders from Founder, Chairwoman and CEO Norma Chu.


Dear Valued Shareholders,


Today we launched our Series A 13.5% Perpetual Preferred Shares, which will trade on NYSE American under the ticker SVOR. Each share has a stated value of $25.00 and pays a cumulative dividend of 13.5% per year, paid in cash every business day. The dividend is supported by a dividend reserve account that holds at least twelve months of dividends at all times, and the reserve balance and its coverage of our quarterly dividend will be published daily at treasury.ddc.xyz. Holders will also receive one-time bonus dividends if Bitcoin holds at or above $180,000, $250,000 and $350,000, totaling up to $4.00 per share.


This is the most important step we have taken this year to strengthen our capital structure. In this letter I want to explain what the offering means for DDC and address the decline in our share price since July.


**Capital structure initiatives**


The preferred offering is designed to broaden DDC’s funding options without adding another instrument convertible into ordinary shares. It has no maturity date, and cannot be converted into ordinary shares.


Our priority is to retire the outstanding convertible note. We may allocate up to 20% of the offering proceeds towards that objective, supplemented by Bitcoin-backed financing and negotiated arrangements. Completion will depend on the proceeds raised, financing availability and final agreements.


We will update shareholders as material retirement arrangements are finalized and when the note has been fully extinguished.


**Bitcoin treasury**


I remain convinced that Bitcoin is the right long-term reserve asset for DDC. Our treasury strategy is unchanged. Our priority in the coming months is to strengthen the capital structure underneath the treasury, so that we can expand our accumulation from a stronger base when we judge the timing to be right.


Volatility is a core part of Bitcoin’s quality. Moreover, volatility comes with being a digital asset treasury company, and our shares have moved more than 30% in a single day in both directions. We cannot control daily trading, but we are focused on the operating performance and capital allocation that underpin long-term shareholder value. We will continue to communicate through our press releases, our filings with the SEC and our earnings releases, at major corporate actions and when we report results, so that every shareholder receives the same information at the same time. This discipline serves all our shareholders equally.


**Our focus**


Our immediate priorities are to complete the preferred offering, optimize our capital structure, and continue strengthening our operating business. We recognize that shareholder confidence must be earned through execution. We will report our progress clearly as these steps are completed.


Thank you to our shareholders for your patience and support, and to our team and partners for their hard work through this period.


Sincerely,


**Norma Chu**
Founder, Chairwoman and Chief Executive Officer
DDC Enterprise Limited


**About DDC Enterprise Limited**


DDC Enterprise Limited (NYSEAMERICAN: DDC) is participating proactively in the corporate Bitcoin treasury evolution while maintaining its foundation as a leading global Asian food platform. The Company has strategically positioned Bitcoin as a core reserve asset while continuing to expand its portfolio of culinary brands. DDC is at the forefront of public companies integrating Bitcoin into their financial architecture. For more information, visit www.ddc.xyz.
